note: Append the objects in `commands` to the existing commands array. F817/0917 is SAE J1979 InfoType 17 (OBFCM / GHG vehicle operation data), not a manufacturer-extended PID — it belongs in OBDb/SAEJ1979, not a vehicle repo. Layout from a real paired capture (2020 Ford E-350, CarDAQ-Plus 3): leading 0x01 item-index, then four big-endian uint32s, Recent then Lifetime distance (÷10 km) then fuel (÷100 L). All-bits-set is the not-available sentinel (nullmax). Confirmed on one vehicle; do not treat constructed Golf 8 hex as a second capture.

signals.name: OBFCM recent distance traveled
signals.description: SAE J1979 InfoType 17 / EU 2018/1832 Annex XXII. Byte 0 of the payload is the item-index (0x01); this signal starts at bit 8. Scale 0.1 km. 0xFFFFFFFF means not available.

signals.name: OBFCM lifetime distance traveled
signals.description: Cumulative distance from the same data source the odometer uses (Annex XXII 2.6). Scale 0.1 km. Resettable on ECU replacement; not tamper-proof evidence.

signals.name: OBFCM recent fuel consumed
signals.description: SAE J1979 InfoType 17 recent window. Scale 0.01 L. 0xFFFFFFFF means not available.

signals.name: OBFCM lifetime fuel consumed
signals.description: Cumulative fuel burned over the life of the vehicle (EU 2018/1832 Annex XXII). Scale 0.01 L.

signals.name: OBFCM recent distance traveled
signals.description: OBDonUDS mapping of InfoType 17 to DID F817. Same payload as service 09 ITID 17: item-index then four big-endian uint32s.
